[[Resin]]|image1=[[fir large.png]]}} Fir is a type of tree that can be found in the [[Black Forest]], [[Swamp]], and [[Mountain]] biomes. It is characterized by its dark brown trunk and long pointed branches. Fir can be found in small and large variants. Both variants can be chopped with a [[Stone Axe]] or better. The small variant produces 4 [[Wood]] when destroyed. The large variant produces 20 [[wood]] when destroyed, and the stump will yield another 2 wood. Fir will sometimes produce a [[Fir Cone]] when destroyed, which can be planted using the [[Cultivator]]. Cutting down a fir tree leaves a stump which is too low to be struck by the regular blow of the axe. To remove stumps, the player must use the alternate attack, which chops straight downward. {| class="wikitable" |+Tree: 50% chance for 1-2 drops !Item !Amount !Chance !Average |- |[[Wood]] |20 |From logs |20 |- |[[Wood]] |2 |From stump |2 |- |[[Fir Cone]] |1 |67% |0.5 |- |[[Feathers]] |1 |17% |0.13 |- |[[Resin]] |1 |17% |0.13 |} {| class="wikitable" |+Small tree ([[Black Forest]], [[Mountain]]): 4-5 drops !Item !Amount !Chance !Average |- |[[Wood]] |1 |83% |3.75 |- |[[Fir Cone]] |1 |8% |0.37 |- |[[Resin]] |1 |8% |0.37 |} {| class="wikitable" |+Small tree ([[Swamp]]): 4-5 drops !Item !Amount !Chance !Average |- |[[Wood]] |1 |100% |4.5 |} ===Planting Firs=== {| class="wikitable" |+Allowed Biomes: !Meadows !Yes |- !Black Forest !Yes |- |Swamp |No |- !Mountain !Yes |- !Plains !Yes |- |Mistlands |No |- |Ashlands |No |} {{Trees}} [[Category:Trees]] [[fr:Sapin]] [[ru:Пихта]] [[cs:Jedle]]

Pine is a type of [[Trees|tree]] that can be found in the [[Black Forest]] biome. It is characterized by its tall, skinny trunk. A [[Stone Axe]] or better is required to damage it.

Pine trees produce [[Wood]] and [[Corewood]] when destroyed. The yield of each type of wood appears to be random, however, a pine tree will always drop 30 pieces of wood total.

[[Pine Cone|Pine cones]] can be planted with a [[cultivator]] to grow more Pine. Pine trees can be planted in the [[Meadows]]. The low drop rate on the Pine Cones makes Pine, and thus Corewood, unsustainable.
